title: relay_client/nntp_client: dot_stuff duplicated in both crates
description: dot_stuff (SMTP/NNTP dot-stuffing algorithm) is implemented independently in relay_client.rs and nntp_client.rs. The logic is identical: allocate a new Vec, scan for leading dot on each line, emit double-dot. Both implementations allocate a new Vec per call. Extract to stoa-core or a shared smtp_util module and replace both call sites.
